brief:
A senior adviser to the Trump-appointed Gaza Peace Council warned that the body could return responsibility for the enclave to the United Nations if Israel fails to meet its commitments, Middle East Eye reported. The statement indicates potential tensions within the governance structure being proposed for postwar Gaza administration.

The Gaza Board of Peace, established under Trump administration auspices, was tasked with overseeing reconstruction and administrative functions in the territory. The adviser's warning suggests conditions attached to the council's continued stewardship of Gaza's governance and rebuilding efforts.

title: Gaza Peace Council threatens to cede control to UN over Israeli non-compliance
